Q: Town A is at longitude 60° E and town B is at 120° E. When it is 7:00 at A, what is the local time at B?
A: 11:00
W: 3:00
W: 13:00
W: 12:00
E: The difference is 60°, and 15° = 1 hour, so 4 hours. B is further east, so its time is ahead: 11:00.
